ai.overview: The Columbus Blue Jackets put their lineal championship belt on the line when they host the Florida Panthers on November 10, 2026. Columbus won the belt and has successfully defended it 1 time in this reign, while Florida has held the hardware 55 times previously in franchise history. This marks the fifth all-time meeting between these clubs with the belt at stake.
key_matchups: Columbus riding a 2-game win streak after back-to-back victories, including a tight 2–1 win over Dallas in their last outing
Florida has been the dominant side in recent head-to-head play, winning 3 of the last 5 meetings including a decisive 7–3 victory on 2026-10-13
Panthers bring offensive firepower after scoring 5 goals in their last win against Chicago, while Columbus has tightened defensively
ai.betting_angles: The Elo model views this as a toss-up despite Columbus holding home ice and winning their last 2 games. Florida holds a 30-27 edge in the all-time series and has dominated recent matchups, including a 7–3 thrashing just last month. The Panthers' 9-7 record edges Columbus at 7-7, though the Blue Jackets have shown improved form with wins in 3 of their last 5.
ai.prediction_writeup: Florida's recent dominance in this matchup is hard to ignore, particularly the 7–3 dismantling on October 13th that showed they have Columbus's number. While the Blue Jackets have won their last 2 games and defended the belt once already, the Panthers' 9-7 record and ability to score in bunches—posting 5 goals in three of their last five games—gives them the edge. The all-time series favors Florida 30-27, and even with the Elo model calling it a toss-up, the visitors should capture the belt on the road.
